entries.label: MGS1 — Blast Furnace
entries.prompt: Create exactly ONE empty 2D fighting-game stage source for CQC Versus Legacy, wide landscape 16:9. This is an accurate painted-HD adaptation of Metal Gear Solid 1 (1998 PlayStation original), NOT the Twin Snakes remake. Inspect and follow the attached original-game reference for architecture, colors, materials and identifying layout. Remove all people, vehicles, HUD, text, logos, annotation arrows and map markers. No collage, no labels, no watermark. Keep a continuous horizontal combat floor across the lower quarter and a coherent readable background. No fake layer split, no spritesheet, no UI. Preserve the reference's distinctive shapes rather than replacing the location with a generic military room. LOCATION Blast Furnace. Preserve the enclosed rusty-brown industrial melting chamber and the HUGE rectangular white-hot yellow molten-metal vat from the reference, with a raised dark steel rim, weathered red-brown square structural columns and enclosed wall plates. The visible rectangular machinery boxes, wall ledges and small metal access walks must read like the same PS1 furnace, not a fantasy forge. Compose a wide side view with the large glowing melt basin behind the combat lane, tall rusted columns flanking it, stacked steel machinery blocks near the sides, heavy girders and pipe shadows above. Orange reflected light, blackened steel, hot-air shimmer near the vat only. Foreground uninterrupted dark brown grated/steel safety walkway with very subtle hazard edges, no lava on the walking floor, no characters or HUD.

notes: Architecture and palette checked against the cited original MGS1 capture/map.
Side-on combat composition is a painted HD adaptation; original camera, dimensions and hidden geometry are not reproduced pixel-for-pixel.
Single static background source; no parallax layers, collision layout or runtime admission in this pass.
